title: Effects of cuproptosis and its application in inflammatory bowel disease (Review).
snippet: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, is a common, recurring, chronic intestinal inflammatory illness that is considered to be impacted by the immune system, gut microbiota and genetic factors.
